title: 第二十五章请教第二十六章王进的震惊与好处

站在一百五十斤重的石锁面前，江宁轻吐一口气，调整好自身的状态。
江宁手掌牢牢抓紧石锁的握把处，随着他的发力，右臂的肌肉顿时明显的隆起，肌肉纹理变得清晰可见。
石锁也随着他力量的爆发石锁骤然离地。
看到这一幕，程然眼中闪过一抹异样的神色。
“我记得江师弟这才学武四天吧！体魄竟然就增强到这个地步，可以提起一百五十斤的石锁，了不得啊！”
江宁把石锁缓缓放下，这才开口：“程师兄谬赞了！普通庄稼汉甚至都可以做到提起两百斤的石锁，我能提起一百五十斤的石锁这算什么！”
“这可不一样！”程然颇为认真的摇摇头：“江师弟身体瘦弱，一看就是是四体不勤五谷不分之人，如今满打满算，最多学武四天，体魄和气力就增长如此之大，可以提起一百五十斤重的石锁，可见师弟武道天赋颇为出众！”
程然一边说道，一边摇头晃脑，神情感慨。
随后，他又问道：“江师弟五禽拳应该在几天前就入门了吧？”
江宁点点头，并非否认：“还是程师兄看的准！”
程然一笑：“那是！不过这也不难看出！江师弟能提起一百五十斤的石锁，必然是气血早已凝练出来，能凝练气血，拳法自然入门！”
说到这里，程然脸上露出惋惜之色。
“江师弟刚刚入门几天，五禽拳拳法五势同修，却是早早达到入门至今，说来江师弟的武道天赋才是高绝，在我之上，也在萧鹏之上。”
“可惜学武太晚了！江师弟若是能早一两年学武，如今大概早已是老师的真传弟子，武道入品的存在，如今则就顺其自然加入巡察府，完成鱼跃龙门之举，如此焉有萧鹏如此张扬的机会？”
说到后面，程然更是连连摇头。
江宁笑了笑，并未多言。
手中一百五十斤重的石锁也被他放了下来。
经过这块石锁的测试，他也大概知道了自己如今的力量为几何。
大概在一百七八十左右。

因为提着一百五十斤的石锁对他的负荷并不算大，他感觉自己还有一些余力，虽然也不多，但是再强行多提个二三十斤却也不难！
“练拳数天，体魄就增强如此之多，此方世界的武道果然神奇！”江宁心中甚为满意：“如今我的五禽拳已然达到精通的境界，现在练拳一遍，就能凝练两缕气血，效率相比之前翻倍！”
“对于体魄淬炼的速度也将大大增加！还有三个月的时间，兴许完全来得及，毕竟我的拳法再突破一次的话，达到小成之境，凝练气血的效率还会提升。”
此刻，程然也似乎打了鸡血。
“江师弟，我不能在此颓废了，我要拳法大成，我要成为王进老师的亲传弟子，我要战胜萧鹏，成为巡察府的一员。如果做不到，我就只能回去继承家中的千亩良田了！！”
继承千亩良田！
江宁：“......”
狗大户！！
单单一千亩良田，那都是大于万两银子的家产啊！！
而且他口中的千亩，也未必是区区一千亩。
狗地主！！
江宁暗暗吐槽一声。
......
午饭过后。
江宁练了一遍五禽拳后，把最后仅存的那份野参也全部吃完，随后他也不再浪费时间，全力练拳。

Standing in front of the 150-pound stone lock, Jiang Ning took a breath and adjusted himself.
Jiang Ning's palms firmly grasped the handle of the stone lock. As he exerted force, the muscles of his right arm suddenly bulged significantly, and the muscle texture became clearly visible.
The stone lock also suddenly lifted off the ground with the explosion of his power.
Seeing this scene, a strange look flashed in Cheng Ran's eyes.
"I remember that Junior Brother Jiang has only been practicing martial arts for four days! His physical strength has strengthened to such an extent that he can lift a stone lock weighing one hundred and fifty kilograms. It's incredible!"
Jiang Ning slowly put down the stone lock, and then said: "Senior Brother Cheng is so ridiculous! Ordinary farmers can even lift a two hundred kilograms of stone locks. I can lift a hundred and fifty kilograms of stone locks. It's nothing!"
"This is different!" Cheng Ran shook his head seriously: "Junior brother Jiang is thin and weak. At first glance, he looks like a person who is indifferent to the four limbs and the five grains. Now he is fully prepared. After learning martial arts for at least four days, his body and strength have increased so much. He can lift a stone lock weighing one hundred and fifty kilograms. It shows that junior brother's martial arts talent is quite outstanding!"
Cheng Ran said, shaking his head with emotion.
Then, he asked: "Junior Brother Jiang should have started Wuqinquan a few days ago, right?"
Jiang Ning nodded, not denying: "Senior Brother Cheng is right!"
Cheng Ran smiled: "That's right! But it's not hard to see! If Junior Brother Jiang can lift a hundred and fifty kilograms of stone locks, he must have already condensed his qi and blood. If he can condense qi and blood, his boxing skills will naturally start!"
Speaking of this, Cheng Ran had a look of regret on his face.
"Junior Brother Jiang has just started training a few days ago. Fellow practitioners of Five Bird Fist and Five Powers have already reached the level of training early. It can be said that Junior Brother Jiang's talent in martial arts is extremely high. He is above me and above Xiao Peng."
"It's a pity that it's too late to learn martial arts! If Junior Brother Jiang could have learned martial arts a year or two earlier, he would probably have become the teacher's true disciple by now. He has reached the highest level of martial arts. Now he will just join the inspector's office and complete the leap. How can Xiao Peng have such a chance to show off like this?"
When talking about the latter part, Cheng Ran shook his head repeatedly.
Jiang Ning smiled and didn't say much.
He also let go of the stone lock weighing 150 kilograms in his hand.
After testing this stone lock, he roughly knew what his current strength was.
Probably around one hundred, seventeen and eighty.
Because carrying a hundred and fifty kilograms of stone locks was not a heavy load on him, he felt that he still had some strength left. Although it was not much, it would not be difficult to forcefully lift an additional twenty or thirty kilograms!
"After practicing boxing for a few days, my body has strengthened so much. The martial arts in this world are really amazing!" Jiang Ning was very satisfied: "Now I have reached the level of proficiency in Wuqinquan. Now that I practice boxing once, I can condense two strands of qi and blood, and the efficiency is doubled compared to before!"
"The speed of physical training will also be greatly increased! There are still three months left, and it may be completely in time. After all, if my boxing technique breaks through again, I will reach the state of small success, and the efficiency of condensing qi and blood will increase."
At this moment, Cheng Ran seemed to be getting some blood.
"Junior Brother Jiang, I can't be decadent here. I want to master my boxing skills. I want to become Teacher Wang Jin's personal disciple. I want to defeat Xiao Peng and become a member of the Inspectorate. If I can't do that, I can only go back and inherit the thousands of acres of fertile land at home!!"
Inherit a thousand acres of fertile land!
Jiang Ning: "..."
Big dog owner! !
Just one thousand acres of fertile land is a family property worth more than ten thousand taels of silver! !
And the thousand acres he mentioned may not necessarily be just a thousand acres.
Dog landlord! !
Jiang Ning secretly complained.
...
After lunch.
After Jiang Ning practiced Wuqinquan once, he ate up all the remaining wild ginseng, and then he stopped wasting time and practiced boxing with all his strength.
